reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin with substantial income and financial-freedom claims tied to recommended customers and recruitment. It urges viewers to join partners, recommend others, provide their name and email, and use an earnings-oriented registration interface. Completed registration, payment, actual earnings, and data handling remain unverified, and the sampled Polish earnings statement is visibly incomplete.

citations.quote: Get into the project now and join the 650,000 partners.
Click in the pol under the video. I want to make money. You will be redirected to the entry registration, where you will only provide name & surname and address email address.
First, commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring.
Second, profits resulting from the growth of the value of OneCoin
Thousands of people earn more than than 5000 € a month.

opening.argument: Judge, the narration gives figures about reported participation and earnings, but those figures are not a promise of what any viewer will earn. Its value claim is difficult to read as a reliable forecast: it says the value increased from one figure to a lower figure, then calls that growth of more than 2400%. The careful reading is to treat these as unverified market claims, not evidence that a viewer is being guaranteed a return. The stated first step asks for a name and email address, not an investment.

citations.quote: Thousands of people earn more than than 5000 € a month.
The value for one OneCoin has increased from 10 EUR CENT to 2.5 EUR CENT in 2015. This is more than 2400% and it is still growing.
You will be redirected to the entry registration, where you will only provide name & surname and address email address.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening quotes earnings examples and a commission description, but neither establishes a guaranteed return for a new viewer. The registration quote establishes a request for contact details; it does not show a deposit or completed transaction. Those limits matter even if the invitation to join is plainly promotional.

citations.quote: First, commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring.
You will be redirected to the entry registration, where you will only provide name & surname and address email address.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: No guaranteed return or completed deposit is needed to identify what the video promotes. It explicitly presents commissions for recommended customers and structure building alongside profits from rising coin value, then directs viewers into registration. The contradictory price figures weaken the claims' credibility; they do not turn the recruitment pitch into detached market analysis.

citations.quote: First, commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring. Second, profits resulting from the growth of the value of OneCoin
Get into the project now and join the 650,000 partners.

opening.argument: Judge, there is an instructional thread here. The narration distinguishes two proposed sources of revenue, and the described partner access includes recorded materials and instructions. The description likewise presents step-by-step information for members. That supports reading the video as an introduction to how the program says it operates, rather than treating every explanation of its mechanics as proof that the viewer has entered a scam.

As a partner of the Wealth Code, you will gain access to the support system, in which you will find the recorded video materials and instructions in Polish.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening accurately identifies an invitation to join, but the invitation also offers access to recorded instructional materials. Naming proposed revenue mechanisms explains what prospective partners would be taught; it does not establish that anyone paid, earned the quoted amounts, or received a return. Those outcomes remain outside the supplied evidence.

citations.quote: As a partner of the Wealth Code, you will gain access to the support system, in which you will find the recorded video materials and instructions in Polish.
In OneCoin there are 2 kinds of revenues.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional material is expressly for partners learning to promote the opportunity, not an independent tutorial. The narration says it will teach viewers to win markets, immediately directs them to an earnings-oriented registration step, and urges them to join. Explaining the commission structure is part of that recruitment pitch.

citations.quote: information that will help them, step by step, in promoting ...
We will teach you how to win international markets quickly and effectively.
Click in the pol under the video. I want to make money. You will be redirected to the entry registration

opening.argument: Judge, the visible entry point looks like a partner sign-up for a promoted service: the narration specifies free registration and asks for a name and email address. It also describes a commission for directly recommended customers, a feature that can exist in ordinary commerce. The supplied material does not show a required deposit, a credential request, a completed payment, or a contractual promise of returns. Assess the observed invitation as a promotional registration, without filling those missing steps in by inference.

citations.quote: Thanks to the easy and free registration, you'll our partner and will gain access to a wealth code.
You will be redirected to the entry registration, where you will only provide name & surname and address email address.
First, commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening's commission quote includes recommended customers, but it does not specify a required purchase or show anyone receiving downline income. Its earnings quote reports alleged results for others, not terms promised to the registrant. The name-and-email step should be judged as shown, without assuming a payment screen beyond it.

citations.quote: First, commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring.
Thousands of people earn more than than 5000 € a month.
where you will only provide name & surname and address email address.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A missing payment screen does not make this ordinary commerce. The promoted opportunity couples customer recommendations with structure construction, highlights exceptional earnings, and tells viewers to register and join the partner project. Free initial registration is compatible with a recruitment-led pitch; it does not explain away its stated income mechanism.
